spec.name: M5.ResidueRecovery.pick_bound
spec.statement: ∀ (T : ℕ) (f : Fin T → ℤ) (xs : List (Fin T)), (M5.ResidueRecovery.pick f xs).2 ≤ xs.length
queries: finite sum positive exists positive summand
spec.guidance: Induct xs; unfold pick and split on positive first count. Each unsuccessful candidate costs1, successcost1, emptycost0. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.

spec.name: M5.ResidueRecovery.pick_positive
spec.statement: ∀ (T : ℕ) (f : Fin T → ℤ) (xs : List (Fin T)), (∃ a ∈ xs, 0 < f a) → ∃ a ∈ xs, (M5.ResidueRecovery.pick f xs).1 = some a ∧ 0 < f a
queries: finite sum positive exists positive summand
spec.guidance: Induct xs. Positive head succeeds; otherwise any positive candidate must be in the tail and the induction witness is retained by pick. This establishes the returned residue as positive, not just list membership. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.

spec.name: M5.ResidueRecovery.recover_success
spec.statement: ∀ (T : ℕ) (c : List (Fin T) → ℤ) (p : List (Fin T)) (n : ℕ), (∀ q : List (Fin T), q.length < p.length + n → c q = ∑ a : Fin T, c (q ++ [a])) → 0 < c p → ∃ q : List (Fin T), (M5.ResidueRecovery.recover c p n).1 = some q ∧ q.length = p.length + n ∧ 0 < c q ∧ (M5.ResidueRecovery.recover c p n).2 ≤ n * T
queries: finite sum positive exists positive summand
spec.guidance: Induct n generalizing p. Positive parent and sum partition imply some positive child (otherwise sum_nonpos contradicts positivity). Every FinT value belongs to List.finRangeT; pick_positive returns such child and pick_bound bounds searchcost byT. Recurse with one fewer coordinate; new prefixlen+n=old prefixlen+(n+1). Add cost<=T+n*T=(n+1)*T. No strict positivity assumption on T is needed separately because a positive sum provides a candidate. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.

spec.name: M5.ResidueRecovery.recover_valid
spec.statement: ∀ (T : ℕ) (c : List (Fin T) → ℤ) (Valid : List (Fin T) → Prop) (m : ℕ), (∀ q : List (Fin T), q.length < m → c q = ∑ a : Fin T, c (q ++ [a])) → (∀ q : List (Fin T), q.length = m → 0 < c q → Valid q) → 0 < c [] → ∃ q : List (Fin T), (M5.ResidueRecovery.recover c [] m).1 = some q ∧ q.length = m ∧ Valid q ∧ (M5.ResidueRecovery.recover c [] m).2 ≤ m * T
queries: finite sum positive exists positive summand
spec.guidance: Apply recover_success with empty prefix and the supplied terminal-correctness condition. Taking m=2*(w-1) later gives the source residue-test bound after the actual conditional A count is instantiated. Do not assume an already recovered tuple. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.
